notes:
PharmacyOS 0.9.0 preview: the pharmacy app, the Owner app and the phone scanner.

- Pharmacy app and Owner app for macOS (Apple silicon) and Android.
- Phone scanner: install the Android app, tap "Use this phone as a scanner for a computer", and scan the pairing code on the computer (This device → Scanner). The pairing screen now also shows a QR to download this app.
- Preview builds connect to a PharmacyOS server on the same computer (the demo). Builds for the hosted service follow once it is online.
- Windows and iPhone versions are coming.
